_comment: AI-ROADMAP Phase 9 — ratcheting completion floors. Seeded from 5,362 production traces. Floors sit COMPLETION_FLOOR_MARGIN (2 points) below the measurement so ordinary week-to-week variance is not an incident. Raise with `npm run test:ai-completion-floor:update`; LOWERING one is only possible by editing this file by hand, which is deliberate — a hand edit is reviewable, a script that lowers floors is a ratchet that does not ratchet.
